The '''Imperial Proclamation of 1710''' was the founding proclamation of the [[Vesperan Empire]]. It transformed the older [[Vesperan Kingdom]] into an imperial state and formalized the elevated political and religious status of the [[Emperor of Vespera]].

== Significance ==

The proclamation gave Vesperan expansion an ideological foundation. It tied monarchy, military command, aristocratic hierarchy, and religion into a single imperial order.

The proclamation also provided the formal basis for later institutions of the [[Imperial Cult]], including the [[Great Temple of Vespera]], the [[Imperial Coronation Ceremony]], and the [[Imperial Religious Academy]].

== Legacy ==

After 1710, Vesperan rulers framed expansion as the extension of a divinely sanctioned imperial system. The proclamation remained one of the empire's core legitimizing documents until the collapse of Vespera in 1949.
